title: Find Anagram Mappings
summary: Given two integer arrays where one is an anagram of the other, return an index mapping from the first array to the second.
statement: Given two integer arrays where one is an anagram of the other, return an index mapping from the first array to the second. Each element in the first array corresponds to an index in the second array. Multiple valid mappings are acceptable.
constraints: The arrays contain the same distinct integers in possibly different orders.
For each nums1 value, return its index in nums2.
hints: Distinct values make the reverse position lookup unambiguous.
Index the second array once, then translate the first array.
positions={value:index for nums2}; return positions[value] for nums1.
The dictionary records the unique required index and avoids repeated linear searches.
editorial: The dictionary records the unique required index and avoids repeated linear searches.

tests.explanation: The values occur at indices [1,4,3,2,0] in the second array.
Each value already occupies the same index.
